characters.name: Mu
characters.age: older adult (described earlier as an older woman)
characters.voice_notes: Kungaupei member and former Minpentai tournament organiser, a mentor figure to Zei and Bai. Calm, soft-spoken, quietly brilliant improviser who stays cool in a crisis; gentle, with wry humour.

characters.name: Zei
characters.voice_notes: Protagonist of the Dzego thread; national Minpentai champion and gifted cryptographer, now supervising drone combat for the Kungaupei and Veridia. Quick, precise, fluent technical explainer; playful with friends; tense, despairing and then elated during the battles (ch26, ch29-30). Occasionally speaks Dzegoban.

characters.name: Bai
characters.voice_notes: Minpentai player, formerly Zei's rival, now his close and affectionate ally. Confident, socially astute, a persuasive negotiator (ch28); steady and supportive under pressure (ch29); teasing humour.

characters.name: Lektor
characters.voice_notes: Respected Veridian general, later head general and overall commander of the Northshore offensive. Forthright, sceptical but open-minded in ch28; loud, firm, commanding when giving orders in ch29-30.

characters.name: Gallowar
characters.voice_notes: Veridian general leading Group North; clipped, businesslike military reports, shouts orders over the command channel.

characters.name: Telpo
characters.voice_notes: Leader of Group Center; short, clipped military reports over the command channel. Gender not stated.

characters.name: Den
characters.voice_notes: High Council member of the Kungaupei (Dzego's shadow defence organisation), Zei's mentor and mission commander. Composed, authoritative, dry and blunt; leads Group South and is killed in ch29 (his ch30 line is a remembered quote).

characters.name: Vakaria
characters.voice_notes: Leader of Group Naval (seaborne drones); brisk military reports, a touch of warmth when praising the Northglade locals. Gender not stated.

characters.name: Emerald
characters.origin: Veridia (AI assistant used by both Veridians and Dzegojans)
characters.voice_notes: The personal AI assistant running on everyone's devices; terse, neutral, analytical status reports in clipped sentences.

notes: IMPORTANT - the book's colour codes look swapped at the roll call: 29:24 is coded D but is the answer to Lektor's 'Gallowar?' and describes Group North (Gallowar's group, confirmed at 29:84 and 30:84), so the speaker is Gallowar; 29:28 is coded G but answers 'And you, Den?' and describes Group South (Den is named commander of Group South at 29:121), so the speaker is Den. Both are listed as exceptions; each letter has only one other line (29:98 D = Den, 29:65 G = Gallowar), so the defaults are Den for D and Gallowar for G. Gladias does not speak in this chapter. V is Vakaria (leader of Group Naval), not Verdow. E is Emerald (the AI assistant). T is Telpo. From 29:65 on, Gallowar, Telpo, Lektor, Den and Bai are heard over the command channel/chat (remote voices). 29:98 is Den shouting in Dzegoban. N-coded written text left to the narrator: 29:121 (on-screen system alert about Rear base #3) and 29:129 (a written first-person message from Deluin - teen male from Redshire, Zei's friend; he speaks aloud in ch31 as letter D - you may want Deluin's voice for its five runs). Gender of Telpo and Vakaria is not stated.
